mechanisms.target_behavior: Open a promising search result instead of continuing a search-only loop.
mechanisms.precondition: step_frac > 0.4 and n('search') >= 8 and n('get_document') == 0 and steps_left > 2
mechanisms.text: You have spent many steps searching without opening a result. Inspect the most promising result with get_document; if the evidence is still inadequate, change the search approach rather than repeating broad or near-duplicate queries. Reserve steps to verify the requested detail and give a complete final answer.
